This '''creature''' was a [[tusk cat]] that [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] rode during the [[Victory Races of Naboo]].

This tusk cat obviously didn't enjoy [[Water/Legends|water]], and thus would not interact easily with the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] or other bodies of water on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was, however, a very good climber in [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous terrain]].
